urls.rationale: M.G.L. Part I Title I Chapter 3 (The General Court) houses the legislative-agent / executive-agent lobbying registration and disclosure regime (sections 39-50), matching the MA 2015 finding.

notes: MA Justia tree is 4-level (Part > Title > Chapter > Section). Intermediate fetch of Title I (parti/titlei/) was required to expose chapter-level URLs. Chapter 3 is the single core_chapter; pass 3 will descend to per-section leaves.
